spec2def(msutb.dll msutb.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

#file(GLOB msutb_rc_deps res/*.*)
#add_rc_deps(msutb.rc ${msutb_rc_deps})

# msutb.dll is all Rust (msutb-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/msutb-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# msutb.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/msutb-rust/src/msutb/msutb_cpp_h.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(msutb_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(msutb_shims PRIVATE cpprt wine uuid atl_classes cicero libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(msutb_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_dependencies(msutb_shims msctf psdk)
add_cargo_module(msutb msutb-cargo msutb.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE msutb-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS msutb_shims psdk reactos_idls uuid_sources xdk)
